review_limits: No paper draft or slide deck was supplied; claims-vs-code review was limited to checking consistency between MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do, its generated markdown header, and upstream code/results in the repository.

summary: The uncommitted changes in MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do (and its companion brief) are clean across all four review dimensions. Both defects from the prior iteration—referencing an unsaved target variable in temp_tgt.dta and recoding incnonwg==1 to missing when computing within-group category shares—have been resolved and gated with exact assertions against MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex.
